verdict.rationale: RevenueCat documents one recurring scheduled job: scheduled data exports delivered to cloud storage or email "on a schedule you control" (docs-7). There is no evidence of general-purpose scheduling of jobs or workflows, and a community request for timed hooks, such as trial-expiry reminders, points to that gap (comm-6). Webhooks (docs-16) are event-driven rather than scheduled. Missing for 10: general recurring job/workflow scheduling beyond data exports, schedule control via API/MCP/agent tooling, time-based triggers or hooks, independent corroboration.
